st.headline: Mary Chia admits disclosure lapses over CPF arrears at four subsidiaries after SGX queries
st.teaser: Mary Chia said the omission was due to gaps in its internal information consolidation and other processes.
fullText: SINGAPORE – Cash-strapped beauty and wellness group Mary Chia Holdings has admitted that it failed to disclose CPF arrears and court proceedings involving four of its five subsidiaries, despite its chief executive being aware of the court notices earlier on.

The admission came in an Oct 9 response to queries from Singapore Exchange Regulation (SGX RegCo), which questioned why the four subsidiaries and their involvement in court proceedings were not disclosed in the company’s Sept 11 announcement, and when the company first became aware of these matters.
Mary Chia’s Sept 11 announcement disclosed $50,208 in outstanding CPF contributions at one subsidiary but omitted arrears and court proceedings involving four others.
All five subsidiaries’ cases had already been heard together on Sept 10, and the CEO knew of their court notices.

The Catalist-listed company attributed this omission to shortcomings in its internal information consolidation and disclosure assessment processes, saying it failed to sufficiently consolidate information across its human resources, finance and management functions when preparing its Sept 11 announcement.
The group said its earlier disclosure assessment had focused primarily on Mary Chia Beauty & Slimming Specialist, whose CPF arrears and court appearance were the subject of SGX RegCo’s initial query.
It said it had not undertaken a comprehensive assessment of similar issues involving other group entities, resulting in the omission of four other subsidiaries from the announcement.
These were Masego, Organica International Holdings, Spa Menu and Urban Homme Face & Body Studio for Men.

Mary Chia also revealed that the outstanding CPF contributions across the five subsidiaries had been revised to $103,727 as at Oct 9, down from approximately $153,000 stated during a court hearing a day earlier.
The revised figure was provided by the CPF Board following a reconciliation of outstanding contributions, taking into account payments made by the subsidiaries towards their arrears.
The latest filing also shed light on when the group’s management and independent directors became aware of the CPF issues.
Mary Chia said its CEO Ho Yow Ping and the group’s human resources manager were aware of the respective notices to attend court upon receiving them.
Ho also attended an interview with the CPF Board on July 22 concerning the outstanding contributions of the five subsidiaries.
The group’s independent directors, meanwhile, first became aware of CPF contribution discrepancies within the group at an internal audit meeting on May 25.
At that meeting, management informed them of the discrepancies uncovered through an internal review, rectification reports submitted to the CPF Board and efforts to settle the arrears.
However, the court notices and related proceedings were not brought to their attention.

Mary Chia said its two current independent directors, Chay Yiowmin and Foo Say Tun, learnt of the outstanding contributions and court proceedings involving the four other subsidiaries only on Oct 8, when management updated the board following that day’s hearing.
The company disclosed that nine separate notices to attend court had been issued by the CPF Board across the five subsidiaries.
Although the matters were initially handled separately, the CPF Board requested in August that the court mentions be consolidated.
All five companies subsequently appeared together in court on Sept 10 and Oct 8, with their cases adjourned to Nov 12.

According to the CPF Board’s updated computation provided on Oct 9, Mary Chia Beauty & Slimming Specialist owed the largest amount, at $52,266, for outstanding contributions covering November 2025 to May.
Organica International Holdings owed $25,248 for contributions covering November 2025 to May 2026, while Masego had $11,341 outstanding for the period from November 2025 to April.
Urban Homme Face & Body Studio for Men owed $9,847 for contributions covering September 2025 to March, while Spa Menu had $5,025 outstanding for February.
The periods refer only to months for which CPF contributions remain unpaid, rather than every month within the stated date ranges.
The revised aggregate amount of $103,727 excludes late-payment interest and composition sums.
In an earlier Oct 9 filing, Mary Chia said its subsidiaries had been making progressive payments under schedules communicated by the CPF Board since June 2026.
The group said payments totalling approximately $29,734 were made on Oct 6 and 7.
It also disclosed that September 2026 CPF contributions amounting to about $12,570 remained outstanding across three subsidiaries, with payment due by Oct 15.
The companies intend to propose an instalment arrangement for their remaining arrears after settling those contributions.

The latest development follows an earlier disagreement between Mary Chia Holdings and its stock exchange sponsor, Evolve Capital Advisory, over the group’s decision not to disclose CPF court proceedings involving Mary Chia Beauty & Slimming Specialist.

cna.headline: South Korea completes Arctic-Europe commercial voyage, eyes regular service despite risks
cna.teaser: South Korean President President Lee Jae Myung has made Arctic shipping a priority, and officials hope to launch regular services by 2030.
fullText: SEOUL: A South Korean container ship completed the country's first commercial round trip to Europe via the Arctic on Sunday (Oct 11), as authorities bank on the route helping turn the port of Busan into a global maritime hub.
The PanStar Acro docked in the southeastern port 50 days after setting sail on Aug 22. Authorities say the Arctic route could cut typical voyage times by around a third.
President Lee Jae Myung has made Arctic shipping a priority, and officials hope to launch regular services by 2030.

But the project risks friction with Western allies hoping to keep Russia isolated during its war in Ukraine. The route runs along Russia's Arctic coast, and Seoul consulted with Moscow about the journey, including whether the ship needed ​help to tackle any problems, such as getting stuck in ice.
On its outbound voyage, the vessel passed through Arctic waters and reached its first European port, Felixstowe in Britain, before calling at Rotterdam and Gdansk and returning home via the Arctic.

The trial voyage also highlighted the challenges ahead. Before the departure, PanStar told Reuters it was seeking about 1,300 twenty-foot equivalent units of cargo, but the ship left with 737 TEU of cargo plus empty containers.
Industry experts have said the route's value will depend on reliable schedules, the costs of slowing to avoid ice, special insurance premiums and extra fuel use.

listening.title: Singapore Expands Solar Panel Rollout on HDB Roofs
listening.transcript: Singapore is accelerating its rooftop solar initiative across thousands of public housing blocks to boost renewable energy generation. The Housing and Development Board announced that newly installed panels will soon power common areas such as lifts and corridor lighting. Officials emphasize that this sustainability push directly contributes to lowering carbon emissions without raising maintenance fees for residents. As energy demands climb, urban solar harvesting remains a cornerstone of the nation's green strategy.

economistArticle.title: The High Cost of Price Controls
paras: Across many advanced and emerging economies, populist politicians face mounting fury over the soaring cost of living. In response, governments are succumbing to the temptation of price suppression, capping energy bills, freezing rents, and threatening supermarkets with price ceilings on staple foods. While such measures offer immediate political relief, they misdiagnose the underlying economic malaise and ultimately exacerbate the very shortages they aim to alleviate.

Price caps act as a blunt instrument that scrambles market signals. When governments artificially depress prices below market rates, demand inevitably surges while supply contracts. Landlords pull apartments off the rental market, energy suppliers scale back investment, and food producers trim production margins. The short-term optical win for voters swiftly turns into a long-term economic nightmare characterized by rationing, queues, and chronic underinvestment.

A far more prudent approach lies in boosting households' real purchasing power rather than tinkering with price tickers. Policymakers should focus on targeted cash transfers to low-income families, tax credits, and policies that bolster labor productivity. By augmenting income directly, vulnerable citizens gain the flexibility to navigate inflationary shocks without distorting the supply chains that sustain economic dynamism.

Furthermore, governments must address the structural bottlenecks that fuel living costs in the first place. Reforming restrictive zoning laws can unleash housing supply, while dismantling trade barriers can lower food import costs. Investing in renewable grid infrastructure cuts long-run power tariffs far more effectively than capping utility bills with state subsidies.

Subsidizing prices masks inflation rather than curing it, consuming vast public revenues that could be far better spent on long-term infrastructure and education. Until leaders shift their focus from suppressing prices to augmenting incomes and unlocking supply, citizens will remain trapped in a self-defeating loop of rising costs and declining standard of living.
economistArticle.cn:
在许多发达和新兴经济体中，民粹主义政治家面临着民众对生活成本飙升的日益暴怒。作为回应，政府正在屈服于遏制价格的诱惑，为能源账单设定上限、冻结房租，并以基本食品的价格上限威胁超市。虽然这些措施能带来暂时的政治解脱，但它们误诊了潜在的经济不适，并最终加剧了它们旨在缓解的短缺问题。
价格上限是一种会打乱市场信号的粗暴工具。当政府人为地将价格压低至市场利率以下时，需求必然激增，而供给则会收缩。房东将公寓撤出出租市场，能源供应商缩减投资，食品生产商则削减生产利润率。为选民带来的短期表面胜利，会迅速演变成以配给、排队和长期投资不足为特征的长期经济噩梦。
一种远为审慎的做法在于提高家庭的实际购买力，而不是捣鼓价格标签。政策制定者应专注于向低收入家庭提供有针对性的现金转移、税收抵免以及促进劳动生产率的政策。通过直接增加收入，弱势群体获得了应对通胀冲击的灵活性，同时不会扭曲维持经济活力的供应链。
此外，政府必须首先解决加剧生活成本的结构性瓶颈。改革限制性的区划法律可以释放住房供应，而拆除贸易壁垒可以降低食品进口成本。投资于可再生电网基础设施削减长期电费的效果，远比通过国家补贴限制公用事业账单更为有效。
补贴价格掩盖了通货膨胀而非治愈它，消耗了巨额的公共财政收入，而这些资金本可以更好地用于长期基础设施和教育。除非领导人将焦点从抑制价格转向提高收入和释放供应，否则公民将继续陷入生活成本上升和生活水平下降的自败循环中。

gems.s: When governments artificially depress prices below market rates, demand inevitably surges while supply contracts.
gems.why: This sentence effectively uses contrasting parallel structures ('demand inevitably surges' versus 'supply contracts') to clearly articulate cause-and-effect in economic analysis. 这句话巧妙地运用对比平行结构（“需求必然激增”对“供给收缩”），清晰地阐明了经济分析中的因果关系。

gems.s: Subsidizing prices masks inflation rather than curing it, consuming vast public revenues that could be far better spent on long-term infrastructure and education.
gems.why: This sentence employs a present participial clause ('consuming vast public revenues...') to smoothly append consequence and critique without breaking narrative momentum. 该句利用现在分词短语（“消耗巨额公共财政收入……”）平滑地附加后果与批判，保持了叙事的连贯性与说服力。
